podcast.body: This album features a hidden track, a cover of a Rush song, which is located at the very end of an unlisted trio of songs. These unlisted tracks appear after listeners typically believe the album has concluded, making it a prime example of a common type of hidden audio on CDs. "It's a hidden track stored at the far end of an unlisted trio of songs that show up after everyone thinks the album is done."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
